paper.title: Parsimonious mixtures of multivariate contaminated normal distributions

stack: R 4.6.2 (sandbox, conda-forge), ContaminatedMixt 1.0 (CRAN archive), mixture 2.2.1, mnormt 2.1.2, mclust 6.1.4 (current CRAN at fetch time)

claim.text: Section 7.3 (wine data), Table 11, CNMs row: BIC-selected (G, parsimonious structure) over G in {1,2,3,4} and the 14 structures, labels ignored, seed 1

values.name: selected_structure_index
values.note: index of EEE in the package's structure order (EII, VII, EEI, VEI, EVI, VVI, EEE, ...); categorical label encoded as a number for the VALUE contract

attempt: authors' ContaminatedMixt 1.0 built with R CMD INSTALL, no source edits; CNmixt called once per (G, structure) under tryCatch, seed 1, BIC via the package's whichBest

original_attempt.reason: a single CNmixt(X, G=1:4) call halted at (G=4, EVE) inside mixture::gpcm ('no models estimated'), which escapes the package's per-job handling; 'invalid subscript type list' failures for EEV, VEV, EVV, VVV at G=2..4 and 'no models estimated' for G=4 VVI and EVE were recorded in the per-fit rerun. Driver-level tryCatch per fit; the package source is unchanged
